style.backgroundSystem: steel-blue studio field #3E6288 with vertical fluted panels, alternating with a pale ice-blue panel #DCE7F0, a deep charcoal band #23262E and clean #FFFFFF information cards; one cool utility-worktop scene only; never wood grain, never pastel home-lifestyle set
style.direction: industrial hardware ecommerce, machined jaw-head specular system on a steel-blue technical field
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in #23262E inside white #FFFFFF rounded-square cards, generic jaw, cutting-edge, wire and grip marks only, no certification crests, no shield or award artwork; hairline leader lines with small dot terminals for feature callouts

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial hardware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of steel-blue studio field #3E6288, pale ice-blue panel #DCE7F0, deep charcoal information band #23262E, and one safety-orange accent #E4661F reserved for keylines, pill tags and the single CTA button, plus clean #FFFFFF information cards; cool neutral tone, never warm; one modern geometric sans-serif family for every Chinese and Latin string, #FFFFFF display type on blue and charcoal fields and #2D2D2D on pale fields; thin single-weight line glyphs inside white rounded-square cards and hairline leader lines with small dot terminals; polished steel rendered under a hard raking side key from frame left so each machined face reads as one bright directional grain streak with micro-shadow inside every serration tooth and notch edge, soft #FFFFFF bounce on the shadow side, one consistent soft contact shadow grounding every part; flat rounded-corner information-card layout with a photo window on one side and a labelled panel on the other; the tool always shown with its jaw head, serrated gripping teeth, round crimp notch and dipped handle sleeves intact at identical scale and identical hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm lifestyle cast, no added logo or watermark.
style.presentationRules: the tool always shown with its polished jaw head, serrated gripping teeth, round crimp notch and dual-tone dipped handle sleeves intact and in the same proportions; identical scale and identical hero angle across shots; the jaw head stays the brightest element under the raking key; #E4661F accent reserved for keylines, pill tags and the single CTA button
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale ice-blue #DCE7F0 resin pedestal and disc props, deep charcoal #23262E woven worktop mat for the flat-lay, cool grey concrete worktop #8C949B for the single in-context scene; flat surfaces only, no reflective mirror plate
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin strings; #FFFFFF display headlines on blue and charcoal fields, #2D2D2D headlines on pale and white fields; #FFFFFF pill badges, hairline rules and thin uppercase Latin kicker lines; every rendered string is a short placeholder, no dense body copy
